topic: Electrons confined to 2D at near absolute zero form a resistance plateau exactly at the 5/2 fraction. Use the 12 edges of the Z-Squared cubic geometry (12=8+3+1) to derive why 5/2 is the only allowable even-denominator topological invariant.
